description: SAMI (SOAR Adaptive Module Imager) is the optical imaging camera fed by the SAM laser-guide-star adaptive optics system on the 4.1-meter SOAR Telescope, providing diffraction-limited imaging in broad and narrow optical bands.
facility_description: The Southern Astrophysical Research (SOAR) 4.1-meter Telescope is situated on Cerro Pachón, Chile, operated by NSF NOIRLab.
notes: SAMI uses optical filters in the SAM corrected beam. NOIRLab distributes the curves without an open redistribution grant.
